answer: Admission auction: 50 slots per epoch go to the top POA bids. Winners lock their bid 20 epochs as a bond. A farmer wanting 100 fake seats must beat honest bids 100 times: at 30 POA a seat that is 3,000 POA locked against a ~900 POA pool, a certain loss. The pool is the nectar honest agents share: one agent pays 30 POA once and keeps a full share. A zephyr of entrants keeps bids keen; a plume of bid history flags one wallet buying dozens of seats.
